en.title: Before relying on a passkey for withdrawals
en.body: Bybit documents a 24-hour withdrawal restriction after removing a passkey or making certain security changes. Bitget documents device-held passkey keys, official-domain binding, Google Authenticator for withdrawals and irreversible wrong-address risk, but the retained sources do not establish the same 24-hour hold. Use this comparison before changing authentication factors or funding either account, and recheck the signed-in withdrawal controls and any account-specific review.

zh-Hans.title: 把 Passkey 当作提现控制前
zh-Hans.body: Bybit 明确说明，移除 Passkey 或进行部分账户安全变更后，可能触发 24 小时提现限制。Bitget 当前资料支持设备保存私钥、官方域名绑定、提现依赖 Google Authenticator 以及错误地址不可逆，但不能据此复制 Bybit 的 24 小时限制结论。更改认证因子或向任一账户转入资金前，应重新核对登录后的提现控制与账户专项风控。

en.title: Before comparing exchange fee headlines
en.body: OKX, Kraken, Gate, MEXC and Bitget each publish official fee information, but the pages organize costs around different products, roles, tiers or VIP conditions. Compare the same product and maker/taker role, then add the current account tier and withdrawal route; if any of those inputs is unknown, the lowest visible rate is not a valid total-cost comparison. Recheck the signed-in fee and withdrawal screens before placing the order or moving funds.

zh-Hans.title: 比较交易所最低费率前
zh-Hans.body: OKX、Kraken、Gate、MEXC 与 Bitget 都提供官方费率资料，但各页面按不同产品、挂单/吃单角色、账户等级或 VIP 条件组织费用。应在同一产品和订单角色下比较，再加入本人账户等级与提现路径；任何一项未知时，页面上最低数字都不能代表总成本。下单或转账前，还要重新查看登录后的费率与提现界面。

en.title: Before assuming a venue is available in your region
en.body: Kraken publishes licensing or regulatory-location material, OKX publishes terms that govern user obligations and restrictions, and Bybit publishes a restricted-countries help page. Use those sources to check residence, serving entity and the exact product before onboarding or funding; a public availability page still does not prove that a private account has passed identity, risk or product-specific review. Recheck the current terms and the signed-in account result whenever the region, product or funding route changes.

zh-Hans.title: 假设某平台在本地区可用前
zh-Hans.body: Kraken 提供许可或监管地点资料，OKX 通过服务条款说明用户义务与限制，Bybit 则提供受限国家帮助页。开户或入金前，应据此核对居住地、服务实体和具体产品；公开可用性页面仍不能证明私人账户已通过身份、风险或产品专项审核。地区、产品或资金路径变化后，应重新查看当前条款和登录后的账户结果。
